segments.name: Telecommunications products
segments.description: Provides mobile recharge, data plans, subscription plans and mobile devices, plus SMS messaging, to consumers and enterprises in China.
segments.evidence: Based on the management's assessment, the Company determines that it has only one operating segment and therefore one reportable segment as defined by ASC 280.

revenueModel.text: Telecom operators pay rebates on recharge payments the company processes, and consumer and enterprise customers pay for its telecom services and devices.
revenueModel.evidence: JiuGe Technology generates revenue by processing payments for telecom services and receiving rebates from telecom operators.
